_comment: Canonical shopping-ingredient tags per recipe, reviewed and corrected by Chef Henry. Staples (salt, oils, dried spices) are deliberately excluded: they match nearly every recipe and add noise to combo matching. recipeTags drives matching; recipeLines holds the original recipe wording for each tag so grocery lists can show real quantities. Regenerate from the ingredient review workbook, do not hand-edit. Em dashes from recipe wording are normalized to commas to match the house writing rules. families group ingredients a shopper buys as one item (chicken breast and chicken thighs are both chicken), so a broad search returns one result with the total across variations. Grouping is explicit, never substring matching: green onions are not onions and cayenne pepper is not a bell pepper.
